site_name: Crusoe Energy (now NYDIG DFM), Kraken Central Site, Richland County
serving_utility: none: on-site natural gas generators at an oil and gas pad
utility_evidence_period: permit final 15 November 2025; its history runs from the first permit of 1 September 2021
notes: Montana DEQ air quality permit 5262-05, at this row's coordinates (Section 8, T25N R59E, 47.93400, -104.13700): 'NYDIG DFM, LLC. (NYDIG) owns and operates a natural gas generator station used to power small data centers on site. The site also contains diesel-fired engines for back-up power generation.' First issued to Crusoe Energy Systems on 1 September 2021; transferred to NYDIG in 2025. The generator capacity the permit file carries for this row is therefore the site's own power supply, not backup for a grid connection. No page names a retail utility, and none says in words that there is no grid connection: that is the reading of a permit for an electrical generation facility on a well pad. The national territory map had put the row on Montana-Dakota Utilities or Lower Yellowstone Rural Electric by the smallest-territory rule. Found by a Sonnet 5.5 lookup; the permit opened and read by the session model.
